name: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited
summary: Spacenet Enterprises India Limited engages in the trading of commodities in India. It operates through two segments: commodity trading and IT services. It offers information technology related services. The company also develops software tools and platforms for commodities trading tools. In addition, the company provides TradFi solutions for structured trade and commodity markets. Spacenet Enterprises India Limited was formerly known as Northgate Com Tech Limited and changed its name to Spacenet Enterprises India Limited in November 2015. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
